purpose: Identify one exact H0 live-validation guest from independently observed non-secret Linux identity fields.

identity_fields.name: target_id
identity_fields.normalization: Strip leading and trailing ASCII whitespace, require ASCII, convert A-Z to lowercase, and require 1-200 hostname characters matching lowercase letters, digits, dot, or hyphen with an alphanumeric first and last character.

identity_fields.name: machine_id
identity_fields.normalization: Strip leading and trailing ASCII whitespace, require ASCII, convert A-F to lowercase, require exactly 32 hexadecimal characters, and reject the all-zero identifier.

identity_fields.name: operating_system_id
identity_fields.normalization: Parse the os-release assignment without executing it, strip leading and trailing ASCII whitespace, require ASCII, and convert A-Z to lowercase.

identity_fields.name: operating_system_version_id
identity_fields.normalization: Parse the os-release assignment without executing it, strip leading and trailing ASCII whitespace, and require ASCII.

identity_fields.name: architecture
identity_fields.normalization: Strip leading and trailing ASCII whitespace, require ASCII, and convert A-Z to lowercase; do not alias architecture names.

identity_fields.name: reviewer_name
identity_fields.normalization: Strip leading and trailing ASCII whitespace, require ASCII, and convert A-Z to lowercase.

identity_fields.name: reviewer_uid
identity_fields.normalization: Require a non-boolean integer and serialize it as the shortest unsigned base-10 JSON integer.

identity_fields.name: reviewer_gid
identity_fields.normalization: Require a non-boolean integer and serialize it as the shortest unsigned base-10 JSON integer.

identity_fields.name: reviewer_home
identity_fields.normalization: Strip leading and trailing ASCII whitespace, require ASCII, and require the exact absolute POSIX path without path rewriting.

canonical_serialization.object_key_ordering: the exact member_order above, not lexical sorting

comparison_policy.comparison: constant-time exact comparison of the 32 digest bytes
comparison_policy.field_drift: recompute and require new separately governed authorization; never substitute, omit, or reuse a prior field
